stem: During a paediatric nasal examination, which structure may be visualised with a light source, inspection of the external nose, and elevation of the nasal tip using an otoscope with a speculum?
explanation: Adenoids may be visualised with this nasal examination technique.

citations.source: Louisa Leone MD3 2025 - Child and Adolescent Health - Study Notes.pdf
citations.title: Louisa Leone MD3 2025 - Child and Adolescent Health - Study Notes

rationale: The described examination technique is used to inspect the nasal cavity and can reveal the adenoids, along with other nasal structures.

optionExplanations.A: Correct because adenoids are specifically listed as visible with this nasal examination technique.
optionExplanations.B: Incorrect because the epiglottis is a laryngeal structure and is not visualised by this nasal examination technique.
optionExplanations.C: Incorrect because the hypopharynx is not part of the nasal cavity and is not visualised in this examination.
optionExplanations.D: Incorrect because the soft palate is not the structure specifically listed as visible with this technique.
optionExplanations.E: Incorrect because tonsils are examined in the oropharynx, not with this nasal examination technique.
